description: Returns the end of the preview's log: the bundle and page errors of the preview open in Xodia, or of Xodia's headless browser when nobody has it open. If it answers that it needs the project open in Xodia, ask the user to open it and don't call it again in this task. Sourcemap warnings about missing source files are harmless and need no fix.
name: get_logs
title: Get logs
